summary: Pterodon's Vietnam War tactical shooter, its PC expansions, and the heavily reworked console compilation.

entries.title: Vietcong
entries.definitive_edition: PC Purple Haze + Red Dawn, with an Xbox two-level mop-up

emulation.emulator: VCStarter for PC compatibility; Xemu for the Xbox-exclusive levels
emulation.notes: Keep a 4:3 fallback for PC if the aspect-ratio fix distorts scenes. Use an owned Xbox disc for the secondary pass.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Patched PC rendering for the complete package, plus high-resolution Xbox emulation for two exclusive levels.

primary.version: Vietcong: Purple Haze with Fist Alpha, Red Dawn, patches through 1.60, and VCStarter
primary.why: The PC Purple Haze package contains the original game and the Fist Alpha campaign, while the free Red Dawn add-on contributes another single-player mission. The console rework cuts the 38 PC levels down to 19, so it cannot replace the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Install a legally owned PC Purple Haze copy, add Red Dawn, apply the incremental official patches through 1.60, then use current VCStarter only for modern-OS compatibility. Test its aspect-ratio option because it can introduce visual glitches in gameplay and cutscenes; use 4:3 if necessary.

secondary.platform: Xbox through original hardware or Xemu
secondary.exclusive_content: Two console-exclusive levels plus new bridging narration and cutscenes
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the two console-exclusive levels and view the console-only bridging material; do not replay the shortened 19-level campaign.
secondary.why: The console version adds this material but removes roughly half of the PC package's levels. Xbox has the stronger console presentation and multiplayer feature set compared with PS2.

all_releases.fidelity: Original base campaign and full PC level design.
all_releases.reason: skip alone: superseded by the PC Purple Haze bundle plus Red Dawn.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC game bundled with the Fist Alpha prequel campaign, maps, and weapons.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete official PC package.

all_releases.fidelity: Official free add-on with one single-player mission and multiplayer content.
all_releases.reason: primary: required for the complete official PC single-player set.

all_releases.fidelity: Retooled console campaign with two exclusive levels and new bridging material, but only 19 levels versus 38 on PC.
all_releases.reason: secondary: play only the exclusive console material; the main campaign is heavily cut and reworked.

all_releases.fidelity: Same shortened console rework with longer loading, weaker visuals, and no multiplayer.
all_releases.reason: skip: Xbox is the better route for the two console-exclusive levels.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC contains the full 38-level package plus Red Dawn; consoles cut it to 19 levels but add two exclusive levels and new narrative bridging. Use PC for the full run and Xbox only for the console-exclusive material.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster or current digital release exists. VCStarter's widescreen correction can glitch gameplay and cutscenes, while the console Purple Haze versions are major reworks that remove levels and scripted sequences.
